scope: Fixed source FIT12 mechanism utility diagnostic; no trained method or transfer claim
scene_rule: FIT lexical first6 indoor and first6 outdoor; pass1; exact frozen subsets.json
flow: Unchanged legacy target-to-source +-2 proposals/masks; explicit geometry/time validity intersection
single: base+0.5*D_d, projected using common union support
pair: base+0.5*(D1+D2)/max(M1+M2,1), projected using common union support; no donor-count amplification
projection: Per patch/frame/channel Euclidean clip(candidate+c,0,1) with exact base sum on union support, 80 float64 bisections then float32 cast; final sum error <=2e-5; support exterior exact base
sameframe_control: Replace donors with base at same coordinates; directions exactly zero, output bitwise base
fixed_temporal_baseline: Pinned old no-DC lambda0.5 arithmetic, central target two frames only; exact prediction parity required
patch_label: Float32 squared RGB residual accumulated float64 over all3channels*2frames*16*16; u1=MSEbase-MSEsingle1,u2=MSEbase-MSEsingle2,u12=MSEbase-MSEpair,u1_given2=MSEsingle2-MSEpair,u2_given1=MSEsingle1-MSEpair
observable_features: Negative valid-support LQ/HVI warped photometric RGB MSE per donor (0 if no support), valid fractions, mean valid source pixel x,y across2frames; no-support location target patch center
observable_sidecar: Separate GT-free stage, selective archive metadata+LQ/flow/valid_mask storages only; fail closed on storage alias with GT/base; no utility or GT fields
utility_stage: Requires frozen observable_sidecar SHA; recompute observable predictions and require bitwise same sidecar rows before opening GT storage
output_arrays: 3072 patch scalar rows only, no RGB/GT/predictions stored
row_identity: subsets.entries zero-based clip_index, target_tubelet4, row-major patch_y*16+patch_x
excluded_archive_access: No hash/load/open of internal17 or other nonselected source tensor archives
